title: Require a visible Task Outcome for every closed Work Item
outOfScope: Rewriting, regenerating, or claiming completion reports for already archived Work Items, including RFE-096.
Resuming, merging, or closing Dependabot PR #441 before this corrective Work Item is merged and closed.
Changing release candidates, tags, provider Releases, public assets, or publication state.
Changing the existing multilingual report locale policy or silently translating user-provided evidence.

sources.reason: Current Task Outcome generation is opt-in through taskOutcomeInput and can complete a Work Item without producing an Outcome artifact.
Closure already has authoritative merged-PR, base synchronization, and branch-cleanup facts but does not emit a durable human-readable receipt.
Mandatory Outcomes cite active Contract and Summary evidence; archive must rewrite those exact paths transactionally so archived reports remain resolvable.
The validator currently requires a PR binding before ai-finish, even though the PR has not yet been created at that lifecycle stage.
ai-finish now has mandatory Outcome runtime dependencies; the installer catalog must distribute the complete dependency closure to adopter repositories.
The Summary validator must recognize the mandatory Outcome link and require its generated artifacts to be accounted for in changedFiles.
Core finish lifecycle fixtures must carry the now-required base Commit provenance so they exercise stabilization rather than fail before it.
A renewed before_edit checkpoint must remain before verification even when a Contract scope update follows a failed or partial finish attempt.
The current documentation calls Outcome generation optional, which conflicts with the user-required report-on-every-Work-Item rule.
The authoritative execution plan requires corrective process defects to close before Dependabot intake and release work resume.

riskAssessment.reason: This corrective changes the required evidence produced before archive and the fail-closed condition before branch cleanup. Incorrect ordering could produce an unbound report or delete the retry branch after report generation failure.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly required a report for every Work Item and authorized continuous corrective execution before subsequent Work Items continue.

preReviewWarnings: An archived Task Outcome cannot claim a merged PR before provider evidence exists; distinguish the pre-merge Outcome from the post-merge Closure Receipt instead of inventing PR facts.
Outcome or Closure Receipt validation must occur before any local or remote Work Item branch deletion, so a failure leaves a retryable branch.
Do not mutate an existing archive manifest after closure; outcome artifacts must be created and bound during ai-finish/archive.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: Every code-mode Work Item generates, validates, renders, and archives a Task Outcome during ai-finish without requiring Summary.taskOutcomeInput opt-in.

The mandatory pre-merge Outcome has deterministic Contract, Summary, verification, base, and head bindings; it explicitly represents that PR/merge facts are not yet available instead of inventing them.
A malformed or missing mandatory Outcome fails ai-finish before archive, and the active evidence remains retryable.
Archive transaction rewrites exact active Contract/Summary Outcome evidence paths to their archived destinations before manifest digests are created.
ai-close-work-item generates and validates a human-readable Closure Receipt from authoritative merged PR, synchronized base, and cleanup facts before deleting either Work Item branch.
A Closure Receipt generation or validation failure blocks remote and local branch deletion and reports the exact reason.
An installed adopter repository receives the full mandatory Task Outcome dependency closure and can finish a no-opt-in code Work Item without import failures.
The Summary validator accepts the mandatory Outcome state only when its generated JSON and Markdown are fully accounted for as Work Item changes.
A renewed before_edit checkpoint always records zero required checks passed, so Contract-scope corrections cannot make the agent-risk gate reject a valid retry.
Successful closure output contains the archived Outcome path and the Closure Receipt path together with PR URL, branch-cleanup fact, base synchronization fact, and next-worktree guidance.
Regression tests cover mandatory no-opt-in generation, pre-merge binding shape, malformed Outcome failure, successful closure receipt, and receipt failure before deletion.
Task Outcome documentation and the authoritative remediation plan state the two-stage report boundary without claiming historical Work Items were backfilled.

This corrective Work Item itself completes Contract, Preflight, implementation, verification, archive, PR, Hosted CI, merge, ai-close-work-item, user-visible report, and branch cleanup before #441 resumes.
guidelines: Use red-first behavioral tests for report presence, bindings, and cleanup ordering; do not rely only on source-text assertions.
Keep the report model minimal and evidence-derived: pre-merge Outcome plus post-merge Closure Receipt, with no invented provider or release facts.
Fail closed before branch cleanup whenever required report evidence cannot be generated or validated.
Preserve immutable archive manifests and do not backfill historical Work Items in this corrective change.
Keep instruction-plan-implementation-acceptance traceability bidirectional and record any newly discovered workflow defect before continuing dependent Work Items.

intent.problem: Although Contract, Summary, archive, PR, merge, and closure are required, the Task Outcome generator remains opt-in through Summary.taskOutcomeInput. RFE-096 therefore completed without an Outcome artifact, and the user did not receive the expected per-Work-Item closing report. The current validator also requires PR data before ai-finish, when no PR exists, so making the old form mandatory would force fabricated provider evidence.
constraints: Generate and archive a complete pre-merge Outcome before archive without fabricating PR or merge facts.
Generate a separate Closure Receipt only after ai-close-work-item has verified the merged PR and synchronized base.
Validate both outputs and stop before remote/local branch deletion if the closure-stage receipt is absent or invalid.
Do not alter historical archives, release state, #441, or report locale policy in this Work Item.
intent.rationale: A two-stage report aligns evidence with when it is actually authoritative: implementation facts exist at finish/archive, while merged PR and cleanup facts exist only at closure. Making both stages mandatory prevents silent report omission without weakening archive immutability or provider-truth boundaries.

rawUserRequest: 这个报告不是一定会出的么？继续。每个工单关闭后必须有可见报告。

declaredIntent.summary: Make the Outcome and closure report mandatory, validated, archived or emitted at the authoritative lifecycle stage, and visible to the user before dependent Work Items proceed.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A normal code-mode Work Item has no taskOutcomeInput in its Summary.
scenarioCoverage.expected: ai-finish derives, validates, renders, and records an Outcome rather than reporting optional skip.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Call the Outcome pipeline with a Contract/Summary fixture that lacks taskOutcomeInput and assert generated JSON, Markdown, and Summary links.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Finish occurs before a provider PR exists.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The Outcome binds local evidence and explicitly marks PR/merge facts as unavailable at pre-merge stage.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Validate the generated no-PR binding fixture and assert the Markdown does not claim merge completion.

scenarioCoverage.expected: ai-finish fails before archive and retains active Contract/Summary evidence for retry.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inject a generator or validator failure and assert the pipeline returns failure without archive mutation.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A mandatory Outcome cites active Contract and Summary paths before archive.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The archived Outcome cites the corresponding archived paths and the archive manifest binds the rewritten bytes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Archive an active Outcome fixture containing exact active Contract/Summary source references; assert the moved Outcome JSON contains only archived replacements.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A merged PR is ready for closure.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Closure creates a validated receipt containing PR, archive Outcome, cleanup, base, and next-worktree facts before deleting branches.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use the existing fake lifecycle runner with archived Outcome fixture and assert receipt generation precedes remote/local deletion.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Closure Receipt generation or validation fails.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Closure fails closed and neither remote nor local Work Item branch deletion is attempted.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inject receipt failure in the fake lifecycle runner and assert no delete/push commands occur.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: An adopter installs AI Cockpit and finishes a no-opt-in code Work Item.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The installed scripts include the Outcome generator, validator, and renderer required by ai-finish, so finish does not fail with a missing module import.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Assert the installer catalog and a real installed-project lifecycle test distribute and execute the mandatory Outcome dependency closure.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Mandatory Outcome generation modifies the active Work Item state.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Summary validation accepts the structured Outcome link and requires both generated report files in changedFiles before archive.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Validate a Summary with a taskOutcome link and exact Outcome files; remove one path and assert Summary validation fails closed.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A Work Item renews its before_edit checkpoint after partial verification and a Contract correction.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The renewed checkpoint records current Contract facts but zero passed required checks, preserving the before-edit ordering invariant for the retry.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Seed passed verification in a Summary, record before_edit, and assert requiredChecksPassed remains zero while current Contract counts are retained.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user explicitly authorized continuous corrective execution and required every Work Item to produce a visible report before the next Work Item proceeds.

rollbackNote: Revert this corrective Work Item as one change; retain historical archives and do not resume #441 until a corrected report-closure lifecycle is merged and closed.
